text: I came to buy medicine for my cat. The shop provided excellent service. They have cat food and medicine. There's also a pet shop in front, and parking is convenient. They also offer pet grooming services.
This location provides comprehensive animal health services, including treatment, care, medication, and vaccinations, all in the same area as the pet mall.

I regularly get my child vaccinated here. I've also had health checkups and microchipping done here. I'm very impressed with the doctors and all the staff. They are always gentle with my child and give good advice. They answer questions via LINE whenever my child has any problems and provide guidance. I highly recommend this place.

I buy cat food here regularly. They often have promotions, and the prices are cheaper than elsewhere. It's a large store with a wide selection of products and plenty of staff who help pick up items and carry them to customers' cars.

So expensive!!! To buy Nexgard Spectra monthly flea and tick medication for my dog, you have to buy two boxes to get a 150 baht discount. A single box costs 1,520 baht. If you buy individual tablets, it's 555 baht per tablet (even more expensive than a single box!). This kind of "promotion" is a total rip-off for pet lovers 😭. Even artificial tears gel, which cost 120 baht at a human pharmacy, costs 170 baht here. It's ridiculously expensive. Pet lovers who want their dogs to have good medication are getting ripped off. Buying two boxes at once is too risky. I've had three dogs die in one month already, and I've even seen cases where dogs died and there was a lot of leftover medication. Medication and pet products are all so expensive. Many pet lovers who can't afford it are really discouraged by this.

This clinic is great. They treat cats like a cat lover. The doctor and the staff are very kind to the cat. My cat was once scared, but now he's not stressed at all. They take care of him, are very patient, and give detailed advice. I feel very comfortable finding a clinic like this. I want to give 100 stars. The treatment is not expensive, it's clean, safe, and there's plenty of parking. Come to one place and get everything you need for your pet. ❤️
